title: Catch Teams
subject: Top-tier legendary catch fights

board.title: Catch Teams — top-tier legendaries — plain fights

method.summary: For the fight that catches each of the 16 strongest zone legendaries (stat total 660 or more) and Arceus, the world boss: the *0 team that wins most often per hour, with lesser legendaries and without any legendary, and two alternates for every member. The fights: a legendary zone's plain fight is the one that catches its legendary — the zone's wild Pokémon first (four battles, where the zone has some), then the legendary. Why time counts: a win gives one throw, and the game gives it a small chance: 1.2% for these legendaries (3 in 255; a Razz Berry raises it), 1% for Arceus. That is about 85 wins per catch on average (100 for Arceus), and two wins are not the same: one fight takes longer than another, so the best team is the one with the most wins per hour. No top-tier legendary on a team: you are still catching those, so none of the legendaries on this board, their forms or Arceus's plate forms is ever on a team or among the alternates; other legendaries may come, as many as fit (the first team holds 2.1 on average). Without any legendary: the second team holds only Common, Uncommon and Rare Pokémon; it wins every fight in 11 of the 17 fights, and the first team makes 8% more wins per hour on average. All Lv 100, *0, not shiny. Ranks don't help here: the legendary's power and HP grow with your team's ranks. Search: from the team the game's own boss logic builds and from its plain-damage team, rounds of swaps on 8 runs per try; the best of the teams along the way on 72 other runs is kept, then every place tries its best replacements once more on 120 runs. The first team's search also starts from the second team and from the team an earlier build's board had for the same fight; that team stays unless the new one is clearly better on 1536 fresh runs (26 of the 34 teams are an earlier team). Moves are shown with the share of turns (48 report runs; a member that fainted on the way, or whose team won before its turn, shows fewer). Move-choice rule: each turn the attack its estimate rates highest, or a status move the foe can get on 3 turns in 10. A boss holds one status at a time (confusion apart), and every sleep/freeze/paralysis makes the next less likely and shorter. Bans: re-fought with vs without on 384 fresh runs, kept only if clearly faster (two standard errors and at least 1%); 17 of the 34 teams have a ban (+17% on average). A member left with only attacks the boss is immune to uses its status move every turn it can land and Struggle otherwise. The wild Pokémon on the way meet the same bans. Numbers from 768 unseen runs (192 for an alternate). Closed fights run at the first hour they open; a fight without its own weather runs in clear weather. Arceus shield (the days before the capture fight): 3 attacks a day for 3 days, up to 6 Pokémon per attack, each once a day; no battle — each Pokémon's higher attacking stat counts (Attack or Sp. Atk, the number shown at Lv 100 and *0), types and moves don't matter; ×1.15 per rank, +10% for a shiny; one form per species.

algorithm.goal: Find the team with the most wins per hour for each top-tier legendary catch fight, with lesser legendaries and without any legendary.
algorithm.engine: The game's own battle engine at build 824f567ed3
steps: Enumerate the 17 fights: the 16 zone legendaries with stat total ≥660 plus Arceus.
Ban every top-tier legendary (the 17 and their forms/plates) from the team and alternates; allow other legendaries as many as fit.
Start from the game's boss-logic team and its plain-damage team; run rounds of swaps on 8 runs per try.
Keep the best team on 72 other runs, then try every place's replacements once more on 120 runs.
Also start from the no-legendary team and the earlier build's team; keep the earlier team unless the new one is clearly better on 1536 fresh runs.
For each ban, re-fight with and without it on 384 fresh runs; keep it only if faster by two standard errors and at least 1%.
Score wins per hour from 768 unseen runs (192 per alternate), with 0.65 s per action on the game's clock.

parameters.throwOdds: 1.2% (3 in 255) for the legendaries, 1% for Arceus
parameters.fightClock: 0.65 s per action at normal speed

acceptance.noTopTier: No top-tier legendary on a team or among the alternates.
acceptance.ban: A ban is kept only if the team is faster by two standard errors and at least 1% on 384 fresh runs.
acceptance.earlierTeam: An earlier build's team stays unless the new one is clearly better on 1536 fresh runs.

gameFacts: A win gives one throw; the throw odds are 1.2% for these legendaries (3 in 255) and 1% for Arceus; a Razz Berry raises the odds.
A fight takes 0.65 s per action on the game's clock at normal speed; the wild Pokémon on the way are included.
The zone's wild Pokémon fight first (four battles where the zone has some), then the legendary.
No top-tier legendary on a team or alternate; other legendaries are allowed as many as fit.
The no-legendary team holds only Common, Uncommon and Rare Pokémon.
Ranks don't help: the boss's power and HP grow with the team's ranks.
A boss holds one status at a time (confusion apart); each sleep/freeze/paralysis makes the next less likely and shorter.
A Pokémon left with only attacks the boss is immune to uses its status move every turn it can land and Struggle otherwise.
Bans live on the Pokémon, not the fight.
Closed fights run at the first hour they open; no-weather fights run in clear weather.
Arceus shield: 3 attacks a day for 3 days, up to 6 Pokémon per attack, each once a day; no battle, the higher attacking stat counts, ×1.15 per rank, +10% for a shiny, one form per species.

shield.rules: Before the capture fight, the players break Arceus's shield together: 3 attacks a day for 3 days, up to 6 Pokémon per attack, each Pokémon once a day. No battle: each Pokémon's higher attacking stat counts (Attack or Sp. Atk, the number shown at Lv 100 and *0); types and moves don't matter. ×1.15 per rank, +10% for a shiny, one form per species.

uncertain: All 17 cards carry both teams' alternates. The board prints one OR line under each member; the lines are taken in order and attached to members 1-6, so a garbled member name cannot shift a rate onto the wrong Pokémon. Every team with a distinct alternate list has six OR lines; Giratina Origin's second team is printed as "the same team" and keeps an empty list.

On this board the alternate rates are plain text (for example `Scizor68`, `Rotom (Frost) (Ban) 67`), not plates: the trailing number after each name is the rate. All stored rates are integers; none is left null.

`(Gan)` and `(san)` are the OCR spelling of `(Ban)`; that alternate is marked `withBan` on every occurrence in the card, and the moves it bans are in the team's `alternateBans`, as the card's BANS section prints them.
The BANS section belongs to the team it follows. Regigigas's Gengar/Lampent section sits after `NO LEGENDARY`, so it is stored on the second team; the earlier draft had it on the first.
Members, moves and the two team titles remain the round-1 transcription; this round fills the alternate lists, their bans, and fixes Mewtwo's second-team alternates and all-but wording.
